assets.name: hero-megacity
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / cinematic science-fiction environment.
Asset type: production hero background art for OSGARD Play desktop website, 2560 by 1440 landscape composition.
Input image is a reference and edit target: take ONLY the scene behind the interface in the TOP HERO HALF of this attached OSGARD design. Reconstruct that scene as a standalone clean wide landscape, preserving the reference's striking architecture, viewpoint, giant planet, waterfalls and atmosphere. Remove every text, word, letter, logo, menu, button, statistic, frame, card, UI panel, border, and graphic overlay. Do NOT reproduce the page below the top hero.
Scene: colossal alien-futuristic megacity suspended over a luminous cloud chasm; extraordinarily tall slender obsidian silver towers at center and right; orbital rings and elegant sweeping bridges with turquoise and soft violet lighting; hovering transport platforms and several distant streamlined spaceships; lush floating islands with huge radiant waterfalls falling into mist; a brilliant huge blue-violet planet dominates the upper center-right sky. One tiny dark human explorer seen from behind stands on an observation platform at bottom center, x=56%, facing the immense city. Position the planet and principal city center between x=48% and x=78%, with a spacious dark atmospheric architectural left third that can receive live HTML headings.
Composition: cinematic widescreen panorama viewed at human eye level from a foreground circular platform, strong layered depth, city towers silhouetted against planet rim, human about 12% of image height. Keep the scene rich and monumental, not empty gradient. Cool black-blue shadows, electric cyan 56F4F5, neon blue 168DFF, subtle violet B65AFF, pearl-white and pink dawn rim light. Photorealistic material detail, AAA science fiction environment concept art, finely detailed architecture, volumetric atmosphere, elegant controlled luminous highlights. Match the reference visual composition closely.
Output is JUST the clean cinematic world background image. Absolutely no visible text or logo, no UI, no webpage screenshot, no split panels, no borders.
